    "Merge the dark 'Pokličite nas za ogled' contact section and the footer so the address and phone number are not repeated twice in a row at the bottom.",
    "On desktop, compact the header into a single horizontal bar with the brand on the left and section links ('Kaj delamo', 'Kje delamo', 'Kontakt') on the right instead of a lone 'Domov' link.",
    "Scale down the oversized 'Inštalacije Rebernik' wordmark in the desktop footer so it doesn't compete with the main call-to-action phone number."
